blocks.html: SPARKLE AND DAZZLE THIS HOLIDAY SEASON AT ROBINSONS MALLS

The year’s most awaited season is made even more special by the shining, shimmering Christmas experience at Robinsons Malls nationwide! Think towering Christmas trees, glistening lights, and dazzling décor – just what you need to make the holidays merry and bright. Add to that a slew of musical performances plus the most entertaining shows and activities for kids, and you’ve got the perfect combination for the best Christmas ever!

This year, Robinsons Malls is pulling out all the stops to make sure every shopper – young and old alike – experiences a most dazzling Christmas. Across all malls, giant white gift boxes with shimmering gold, red, and green ribbons bedeck the atrium along with red and gold garlands as accents. Sparkling warm white LED lights illuminate the mall for a truly festive feel.
At Robinsons Magnolia, a 35 foot-tall tree sparkles in elegant silver, blue, and magenta as white LED lights create a unique glistening effect.
At Robinsons Place Manila, a glittering 34-foot tree is decked with whimsical candy accents, gold and red flowers, and enhanced with warm white LED lights for added sparkle.
At Robinsons Novaliches, an outdoor holiday tree stands tall at 65 feet, with its graceful steelworks and colorful rattan matting creating the illusion of a beautiful piece of modern art.

That’s not all there is. The holiday visual treat for shoppers and spectators continues with the much-awaited Giant Lantern Festival, which kicks off at Robinsons Starmills Pampanga on Dec 19, with nightly shows happening at 6:30pm and 7:30pm until January 6.
Get ready to “ooh” and “aah” during the grand fireworks display happening across the many Robinsons Malls in the country.

Make beautiful music with your favorite artists as Robinsons Malls puts together the most dazzling entertainment shows this season. Catch Ely Buendia, The Company, Sitti Navarro, Juris Fernandez, and Morisette Amon live as they serenade shoppers with the hottest hits and all-time favorite Christmas tunes.

And what would Christmas be without a little something for the kids? The exciting lineup of special shows and activities are sure to get them in the holiday mood, starting with the Jungle Book Jive, a live show from Australia featuring Mowgli and his friends. To top it off, Robinsons Place Lipa opens the doors of the Jungle Book Playland, while the Jungle Book Jive Photoland lets kids take souvenir photos of this memorable experience.

Animated mechanical displays bring children to a world they can only imagine: the Winter Park and the Winter Wonderland. And for little girls, their favorite whimsical doll Lalaloopsy is set to weave some Christmas magic during the meet and greet at Robinsons Galleria, Manila, and Magnolia.

Feast Your Eyes on these Delightful Displays
The Giant Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony signals the start of the holiday season at the following Robinsons Malls: Robinsons Place Manila on Nov 11; Robinsons Angeles on Nov 13; Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Novaliches, and Robinsons Starmills on Nov 14; and Robinsons Place Malolos and Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on Nov 15. Get ready for some celebrity sightings on these dates!

Animated displays run starting Nov 15 at Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Gensan, Robinsons Place Dumaguete, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Ilocos, Robinsons Fuente and Robinsons Cybergate Cebu.

The Giant Lantern Festival Competition kicks off on December 19 at 6pm at Robinsons Starmills. Nightly shows of the Giant Lanterns happen from Dec 20-23, Dec 25-30, and finally on Jan 1-6 at 6:30pm and 7:30pm.

The Jungle Book Photoland opens its doors starting Nov 14 at Robinsons Place Las Piñas, and Nov 15 at Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, and the Jungle Book Playland at Robinsons Place Lipa. Watch out for your favorite teen stars at the grand opening!

Make Every Kid’s Holiday Dream Come True
Lalaloopsy, every girl’s favorite rag doll, comes to life at Robinsons Place Manila on Dec 4, Robinsons Galleria on Dec 5, and Robinsons Magnolia on Dec 6. All shows start at 3pm and 5pm.

The Jungle Book Jive is sure to get kids up on their feet as they reunite with familiar characters from the classic Jungle Book animated movie live and in the flesh: Mowgli, Baloo, and Bagheera. Prepare to make some new friends too as Explorer Eddy goes on a journey to find Mowgli. Along the way, there will be dancing and feet-tapping to jungle beats, and exciting games to boot! The Jungle Book Jive starts the ruckus at Robinsons Metro East and Robinsons Place Tacloban on Nov 28; Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Place Las Piñas and Robinsons Place GenSan on Nov 29; Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Santiago, and Robinsons Town Mall Malabon on Nov 30; Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, and Robinsons Place Butuan on Dec 5; Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Palawan, and Robinsons Place Dumaguete on Dec 6; Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Angeles, and Robinsons Place Iloilo on Dec 12; Robinsons Place Antipolo, Pangasinan, and Roxas on Dec 13; Robinsons Sta. Rosa and Robinsons Place Bacolod on Dec 19; Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Place Malolos, and Robinsons Fuente on Dec 20; and Robinsons Magnolia and Novaliches on Dec 21.

Never Miss a Beat with these Musical Shows
Ely Buendia will be at Robinsons Galleria on Dec 11, Robinsons Place Manila on Dec 18, and Robinsons Magnolia on Dec 19. Shows start at 6pm.
Sitti Navarro performs onstage at Robinsons Metro East on Dec 12 at 4pm, Robinsons Place Lipa on Dec 13 at 5pm, and Robinsons Place Las Piñas on Dec 19 at 5pm.
The Company will serenade audiences at Robinsons Place Manila on Dec 12, Robinsons Magnolia on Dec 13, and Robinsons Galleria on Dec 18. Shows start at 5pm.

Juris Fernandez will sing best-loved hits at Robinsons Place Imus on Dec 6, Robinsons Place Antipolo on Dec 12, Robinsons Place Malolos on Dec 13, and Robinsons Place Angeles on Dec 20. Shows start at 5pm.
Morisette Amon will be onstage at Forum Robinsons on Dec 6, Robinsons Sta. Rosa on Dec 12, and Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on Dec 13. Shows start at 5pm.
